PacifidlogTown_Text_FastRunningCurrent:
The sea between PACIFIDLOG and SLATEPORT has a fast-running tide.
If you decide to SURF, you could end up swept away somewhere else.
PacifidlogTown_Text_NeatHousesOnWater:
See, isn't it neat? These houses are on water!
I was born here!
PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary:
The SKY PILLAR?
…Oh, you must mean that tall, tall tower a little further out.
If you asked me, I wouldn't climb it. It's too scary to get up that high.
Life at sea level in PACIFIDLOG, that suits me fine.
PacifidlogTown_Text_TownSign:
PACIFIDLOG TOWN
“Where the morning sun smiles upon the waters.”
